meta.name: font-features
meta.description: This skill should be used when inspecting or applying advanced OpenType features of a font (woff2/otf/ttf) — ligatures, stylistic sets (ss01–ss20), character variants (cvXX), texture healing, slashed zero, tabular/oldstyle figures, fractions, small caps, case-sensitive forms — and generating the CSS to enable them. Interviews the user via cenno to pick features. Triggers on "OpenType features", "font features", "stylistic sets", "ligatures", "texture healing", "tabular figures", "what can this font do".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并应用字体的高级排版特性，自动生成启用它们的CSS代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在网页中精细控制字体的连字、数字样式等OpenType特性
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and apply advanced font typographic features, auto-generating CSS to enable them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fine-grained control over OpenType features like ligatures and numeral styles in web projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的字体文件（woff2/otf/ttf），通过问答了解你想启用的连字、数字样式、大小写等 OpenType 特性，然后自动生成对应的 CSS 代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“OpenType features”、“font features”、“stylistic sets”等关键词，或询问“这个字体能做什么”时触发。

say.text: 检查这个字体有哪些 OpenType 特性
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本扫描字体文件并列出可用特性。

say.text: 为 Monaspace Neon 生成启用连字和表格数字的 CSS
say.note: Claude 会生成 CSS 并建议最佳写法。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude inspects your font files (woff2/otf/ttf), asks which OpenType features you want (ligatures, numerals, etc.), and generates the CSS to enable them.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "OpenType features", "font features", "stylistic sets", or "what can this font do".

say_en.text: Check what OpenType features this font has
say_en.note: Claude runs a script to list available features.

say_en.text: Generate CSS for Monaspace Neon with ligatures and tabular figures
say_en.note: Claude produces the CSS with best practices.
